title: Higher-Order Interaction Reconstruction via Integral Physics-Informed Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.21935v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reconstructing higher-order interactions is a fundamental challenge in complex networked systems, with applications in ecological, social, and biological networks. This inverse problem is inherently difficult due to the combinatorial complexity of higher-order structures, the strong nonlinearity of the underlying dynamics, and the prevalence of noisy and sparse observations. In this article, we propose a novel integral physics-informed neural network (IntegralPINN) framework for higher-order interaction reconstruction. Instead of { penalizing derivative-based physics residuals,} we adopt an integral formulation over temporal intervals, which naturally suppresses high-frequency noise and mitigates derivative-induced instability. We further introduce a continuous parameterization of interaction tensors, enabling tractable identification of higher-order structures via gradient-based optimization. translated_title: 基于积分物理信息神经网络的高阶交互重构
translated_abstract: 重构高阶交互是复杂网络系统中的一个根本性挑战，在生态、社交和生物网络中具有广泛应用。由于高阶结构的组合复杂性、底层动力学的强非线性以及噪声和稀疏观测的普遍存在，这一逆问题本质上十分困难。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的积分物理信息神经网络框架用于高阶交互重构。与惩罚基于导数的物理残差不同，我们采用时间区间上的积分形式，这能够自然地抑制高频噪声并缓解由导数引起的不稳定性。我们进一步引入了交互张量的连续参数化，使得可以通过基于梯度的优化来可行地识别高阶结构。我们提供了理论分析，建立了（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出积分物理信息神经网络框架，以时间区间上的积分形式代替基于导数的物理残差惩罚，并结合交互张量的连续参数化，从而实现复杂网络中高阶交互的有效重构，同时抑制噪声并增强训练稳定性。
en_tdlr: Proposes an integral physics-informed neural network (IntegralPINN) framework that replaces derivative-based physics residuals with integral formulations over temporal intervals and employs continuous parameterization of interaction tensors, enabling robust reconstruction of higher-order interactions in complex networked systems while suppressing noise and improving training stability.
